About.title: About
About.intro: From renting a place at 15 to being Brazil's #1 trader — the full journey behind Ai X Pulse v1.
story: My name is Alesson Felipe, 36 years old today. I've always been a simple person with big dreams. At 15, I was already renting a place with my wife, who was 16 at the time — just a bed, a mattress, a stove, and a gas canister. I spent seven years working at a beverage warehouse that supplied the beach vendors of Boa Viagem, in Recife. I used to watch the buildings along the shore and the cars driving down the seafront, picturing myself one day moving out of that rental, with a decent car to take my family out in.

It was at that warehouse that I bought my first PC, paying it off little by little. I taught myself computing, downloading guides from the internet — formatting computers, installing Windows, then slideshow discs and CD compilations. I left the warehouse job, went to work as a waiter's assistant, and kept dreaming: one day I'd give my family what I saw successful people doing every day.

I started studying how to make money online — affiliate systems, dropshipping. Affiliates didn't work out, but dropshipping did: I sold my first R$10,000, R$15,000 importing from China. When marketplaces started banning dropshippers in Brazil, I learned to code and built my own online store. Traffic was the problem, so I went after marketing, automated posting in Facebook groups, and ended up with over 100 recurring customers in an affiliate system I built myself — until that also ran into account bans.

At the end of 2015 I discovered binary options. I lost a lot of money at first. I studied it in depth — probability, tops and bottoms, uptrend/downtrend lines, pullbacks — until I became the #1 trader in Brazil and Top 5 in the world on IQ Option, in 2019.

The binary options accounts eventually got banned too, and that's how I ended up in forex. I tried applying the same strategy — it didn't work, so I went back to studying from scratch, this time focused on market structure and automated strategy. Between 2022 and 2023 I lost money chasing miracle robots, buying HFT EAs that promised to turn a little into a lot overnight. I fell for scams more than once.

So I decided to develop my own EA — a hybrid HFT/scalper model, since serious brokers don't allow pure HFT. That's when profit started becoming consistent. And that's also when I learned the most important lesson: without a target and without compound interest, an account blows up. Today, Ai X Pulse v1 is that lesson applied — a realistic daily target, aiming for a high return over the long term through compound interest, not the empty promise of getting rich overnight.

I'm still married to my wife after more than 21 years — she's been through every high and low of this journey with me — and today I'm a father of three. I'm a Christian, and it was my faith that kept me steady through the hardest periods.
If you've ever fallen for a scam, tried everything and gotten frustrated, or just want to see your money actually working for you — that's exactly why Ai X Pulse v1 exists.

HowItWorks.title: Ai X Pulse v1 — How It Works
HowItWorks.intro: An Expert Advisor built specifically for XAU/USD (Gold) on MetaTrader 4 — automated, goal-driven, and with configurable risk management.

benefits.heading: Why Ai X PULSE Is Different?

items.title: Gold-Focused (XAU/USD)
items.body: Built and calibrated specifically for gold's behavior — not a generic robot adapted to fit.

items.title: Goal-Based Operation
items.body: You set how much you want to earn per day, week, and month. Once the target is hit, the robot closes everything and pauses automatically.

items.title: Flexible Risk Management

items.title: Smart Profit Protection
items.body: The robot tracks open trades and protects gains as the market moves in your favor.

items.title: Real-Time Dashboard
items.body: Balance, daily/weekly/monthly profit, open trades, and robot status directly on the chart.

items.title: Full Control
items.body: Buttons to pause, resume, or close trades at any moment.

items.title: Time Filter
items.body: Only trades during the high-liquidity hours you configure.

technical.heading: How It Works Under the Hood

steps.title: Entry Strategy
steps.body: Continuously monitors the market and positions orders strategically around price. When gold breaks out with strength in one direction, the robot enters in favor of that move, with entry distance that adapts automatically to current market conditions.

steps.title: Volatility Filter
steps.body: Only opens trades when it detects real market expansion — staying out during sideways, directionless periods, which is exactly where most robots lose money to unnecessary costs.

steps.title: Position Management
steps.body: Tracks each trade and adjusts protection as profit builds, reacting quickly to price changes to preserve accumulated gains.

steps.title: Trend-Following
steps.body: Once a direction is identified, the robot trades only in favor of the trend — and automatically resolves conflicting positions if the market spikes both ways at once.

steps.title: Goals & Auto-Pause
steps.body: Tracks cumulative results per day, week, and month (in value or percentage). Once the target is hit, it closes everything and pauses until the next period.

steps.title: Configurable Risk Management
steps.body: Three lot-sizing modes: fixed lot, balance-based lot (scales with account size), or percentage risk calculated on account balance.

steps.title: Broker Overload Protection
steps.body: Internal safeguards prevent excessive requests to the broker — a common technical issue that triggers alerts and blocks — keeping operation stable even on stricter brokers.

steps.title: Time & Spread Filter
steps.body: Only trades within the configured time window (down to the minute) and respects a maximum spread ceiling.

steps.title: Visual Control Panel
steps.body: On-chart interface showing balance, equity, floating profit, results by period, open/pending trades, session status, and manual control buttons.

risk.body: Ai X Pulse is an automated trading tool. Like any operation in financial markets, it involves risk, and past results don't guarantee future ones. We strongly recommend testing on a demo account before trading real capital, and always using risk management suited to your profile.
